action_items.item: Gemini playground test is flaky under parallel pytest-xdist load (503 'Gemini is temporarily unavailable: ChatError' on concurrent runs; passes consistently when run alone or via the browser check). Likely upstream rate limiting under concurrency, not an app defect. No action required unless it reproduces outside of parallel test execution.

checks.name: test_tscheck_auth_dashboard.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/overview without cookie -> 401. POST /api/auth/demo -> 200 {email: demo@skipti.ai}. GET /api/overview (authed) -> 200 {persona_entries>=6, project_count>=2, projects include both seeded project ids}.

checks.name: owner-login-shows-seeded-dashboard
checks.evidence: Clicked 'Enter demo workspace' on /login, dashboard-stat-grid rendered with approved-entries>=6 and project-holders>=2; also re-verified through the public preview URL (owner-login-shows-seeded-dashboard-preview) with the same assertions.

checks.name: test_tscheck_persona_onboarding.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/interview/start -> 201 {session_id, question}; POST /api/interview/answer -> 200. POST /api/persona/entries -> 201 (owner_id set); entry visible in GET /api/persona; DELETE /api/persona/entries/{id} -> 200 and entry removed. Unauthenticated POST /api/persona/entries -> 401.

checks.name: persona-interview-and-context-entry
checks.evidence: /setup: started interview, submitted an answer, skipped a question, question text progressed. /context: added tscheck-browser-entry via context-add-form, verified it rendered under its category, deleted it via its own delete button, verified removal.

checks.name: test_tscheck_context_router.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/context/search with project_id=11111111... -> 200 with non-empty selected[], available_count, excluded_count, approximate_tokens, project_revision>=1; no selected item referenced the other seeded project id. Unauthenticated request -> 401.

checks.name: context-router-minimum-disclosure
checks.evidence: /context router form: submitted a query, context-router-results showed selected-count > 0 plus excluded-count and token-count.

checks.name: test_tscheck_project_continuity.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/projects/{id}/proposals -> 201 (base_revision = current rev). Approval with wrong expected_revision -> 409. Fresh proposal + correct expected_revision approval -> 200, checkpoint.revision = rev+1; GET /history contains that revision. Unauthenticated GET /api/projects/{id} -> 401.

checks.name: project-holder-approve-checkpoint
checks.evidence: On /projects/{skipti-ai-id}: submitted project-progress-input, captured created proposal id from the POST /proposals response, clicked its approve button, confirmed the approve POST returned 200 and the proposal row switched to the 'approved' label.

checks.name: test_tscheck_gemini_playground.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/playground/ask -> 200 with non-empty answer and retrieval.selected non-empty, excluded_count and project_revision present, when run solo (confirmed twice). Under parallel pytest-xdist execution it occasionally returns 503 'Gemini is temporarily unavailable: ChatError' (upstream concurrency/rate-limit), reproduced on 2 parallel runs, passed both times when rerun alone.

checks.name: playground-gemini-response-with-trace
checks.evidence: /playground: selected Skipti AI project, asked a question, awaited POST /api/playground/ask (200), rendered playground-answer-text (>10 chars), playground-mcp-tool-name, playground-trace-panel, playground-selected-context-list all visible; zero non-favicon console errors.

checks.name: test_tscheck_mcp_streamable_http.py
checks.evidence: Unauthenticated POST /mcp/ initialize -> 401. Real mcp SDK streamablehttp_client with Bearer skipti-demo-mcp-2026: initialize succeeded, list_tools() included get_project_progress and search_context, call_tool('get_project_progress', {project_id}) returned the project JSON containing the project id, call_tool('search_context', {query:'status'}) returned a 'selected' payload.

checks.name: test_tscheck_persona_pass.py
checks.evidence: POST /api/shares -> 201 with connect_url+qr_data_uri. POST /api/shares/redeem -> 200 (status active); replay with same token -> 410. GET /api/guest/context -> 200 with grant+persona_entries. Owner POST /api/shares/{id}/revoke -> 200. Guest GET /api/guest/context after revoke -> 401. Unauthenticated POST /api/shares -> 401.

checks.name: persona-pass-redeem-and-revoke
checks.evidence: /share: generated pass (POST /api/shares 201), navigated to /connect/{token}, redeemed (200), guest session page showed connect-session-status; replay redeem on same token -> 410 with connect-redeem-error shown; owner revoked via /share (200); guest reload of /connect/session showed connect-session-ended (401 confirmed).

checks.name: test_tscheck_exports_isolation.py
checks.evidence: GET /api/persona/export -> 200 markdown containing 'Revision' and revision>=1, no leaked 'sensitive' marker before the revision line. GET /api/projects/{A} and /api/projects/{B} -> each 200; neither project's name or id string appears inside the other's response payload.
